Account — Inventory - cost

This form allows to rename built-in Inventory - cost account.

To access this form, go to Settings, then Chart of Accounts, then click Edit button for Inventory - cost account.

The form contains the following fields:

Name

Name of account. The default name is Inventory - cost but it can be renamed.

Code

Enter code of the account if desired

Group

Select group on Profit and Loss Statement under which this account should be presented.

Click Update button to save your changes.

This account cannot be deleted, it is automatically added to your Chart of Accounts when you have at least one inventory item.

For more information see: Inventory Items
